decision: STRING MIGRATION ('row' -> row-none, spec §1.5) + PARTIAL, RULED 2026-10-01: Cornell. cornell_ext 'Globe Artichokes Growing Guide': "Plant root divisions (basal stem pieces with attached roots) after last frost, 2 to 3 feet apart in rows 2.5 to 3 feet apart." -> in_row [24,36], rows [30,36]. The crop is perennial-culture (herbaceous_perennial; plants reach four feet across), so the perennial figure is the default. Today's [18,36] was a declared two-source blend ('18 to 36 inches apart depending on whose spacing you follow'). ALTERNATIVE, not authored: usu_ext_artichoke 'Space plants 18 inches apart in the row, with rows 2-3 feet apart', which is Utah annual culture (planted for chilling, 'Imperial Star works well as an annual'). Other cited pages agree with Cornell: TAMU EHT-065 2.5-3 ft in rows 3-4 ft; OSU 2-3 ft; UMaine 2 ft. Restatements: the beginner '1.5 ft between plants, 2-3 ft rows' and the seasoned blend sentence are re-authored to Cornell; LSU's attributed regional 'at least 3 feet' (se_gulf z8) now sits inside the default.
